title: lone use-item after code with misplaced comment
description: crates/kith-peer/src/lib.rs line 1063: 'use kith_core::unix_secs_to_rfc3339' appears in the middle of the file, after hundreds of lines of impl blocks, with only a regular comment above it. Rust allows use-items anywhere, but placing one here with no cfg-gate or feature gate is unconventional and suggests it was a stray import left when the unix_secs_to_rfc3339 helper function was deduplicated. The comment '// Format a Unix timestamp...' describes the imported item, not a code section. The use-item should be moved to the top-level use block at the top of the file where all other imports live.
